description: Bundled Claude Code / MCP skill for GA4GH Variation Representation Specification (VRS), shipped alongside the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-ga4gh-vrs` Cordis plugin and standalone MCP server in the `ga4gh-plugins` monorepo. Normalize a genomic variation expression (HGVS, gnomAD VCF, or free-text) against a configured GA4GH Variation Representation Specification (VRS) normalization service and return the normalized VRS variation object. Use when the user asks to normalize a variant description, convert a variant to VRS form, or work with the GA4GH VRS standard for computational variant representation.
